items.headline: Kyle Monangai scores 2 TDs as the Chicago Bears beat the New York Jets 23-12
items.description: — Kyle Monangai rushed for 146 yards and two touchdowns, and the Chicago Bears stuffed the New York Jets for a 23-12 victory on Sunday.

items.headline: Minkah Fitzpatrick records INT, snapping Jets' record drought
items.description: The Jets snapped one of the most ignominious droughts in NFL history Sunday when Minkah Fitzpatrick intercepted a pass by Bears quarterback Tyson Bagent.

items.headline: Jets rookie Kenyon Sadiq has been a necessity instead of a 'luxury' draft pick
items.description: New York used its second (No. 16) of three first-round picks on the tight end out of Oregon.
